scope: Eight fixed synthetic, single-structure, unobstructed gable/hip roofs. No field accuracy, typing of valleys, wrong-building selection or untouched real holdout tested.
provenance: Independent closed-form 3D vertices and source-local edges, seeded repository renderer, 0.1 m pixels; no customer data.

method.matching: One-to-one greedy minimum of the worse of two reversible endpoint distances. Four raster pixels distinguish correspondences; type is scored after assignment. Facets maximize planar polygon IoU above 0.50.
method.length: Sum emitted polyline segment lengths using the exact fitted edge factor via summarizeEngine(...,true). Includes matched, finite lines regardless of type; misses and extra lines are listed separately.
method.quantiles: Median midpoint, nearest-rank p95, maximum. Absolute feet for individual edges and absolute percentage for whole-roof sloped area. Internal diagnostics only.
